recentItems.title: Cyber Insurance Explained: Risk Preparedness in a Digital World | Insurance Ki Pathshala EP5
recentItems.description:
HDFC ERGO General Insurance presents Insurance Ki Pathshala, a knowledge platform where industry experts decode insurance concepts and share insights on emerging trends and developments.

In the latest episode, Sriram Naganathan, President & CTO, HDFC ERGO General Insurance, joins Pavan Duggal, Senior Advocate, Supreme Court of India & Cyber Law Expert, for an insightful conversation that brings together the perspectives of cyber insurance and the complex realm of cyber threats and breaches. Together, they emphasise on why businesses must be prepared for the growing risks of a digital world, and how cyber insurance can play a critical role in helping businesses and individuals respond and recover from cyberattacks threatening data, finances and operations.
